name: Berserkers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry · special · 245 leadership · Seasonal (S7: Wolves of Ragnarok)
pitch: A mobile flanking unit with incredible damage output and sustain that can single-handedly swing fights through smart positioning and combo execution. Loses to pikes, cavalry, and big burst units, so save it for flanks and hero-fight swings rather than a frontal push.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.

doctrines.name: Linebreaker Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 attacks: block-break boost vs enemy units, 2s.

veterancy.label: Top-line
veterancy.body: More defensive — kill more, stay in fight longer. ~6,500 HP on Frenzy heal.

battleRole.positioning: Won't do well face to face — use as a flanking elite strike-force or special-ops unit. High mobility and ranged resistance let it capture uncontested points or rapidly reinforce a hero fight. Watch the map; pull Berserkers to swing a losing fight decisively. {2}
battleRole.tips: Control Frenzy timing carefully — unit loses direct control during activation and may attack the nearest target instead of your chosen one. {2} The 3.08s cooldown on Berserker Assault (skill 2) drops to 2s with the unique doctrine's 20% reduction. {1} Hiding Berserkers before a surprise charge (behind a corner, under stairs, inside a shield wall) lets enemies hesitate to commit. {2} Check for pikes and cavalry first — those are the hard counters; if absent, charge confidently. {2}

cards.name: Pike units
cards.why: hard counter to the unit; formation-breach tricks can let even blue-tier Halberdiers kill Berserkers

cards.name: Imperial Javelineers
cards.why: best direct counter beyond pikes/cavalry — excels at taking down high-health targets

cards.name: Prefecture Pikemen
cards.why: decent at killing Berserkers when charging into them

cards.name: Ranged units
cards.why: generally struggle vs Berserkers: high ranged resistance + fast charge closes distance

cards.name: Men-at-Arms
cards.why: a frontal (not even flanking) Berserkers push obliterates them — can't hold a line the way top-tier T4 units can

matchups.pressure: You pressure: no specific units named — a great flank unit that provides lots of DPS in a fight.

controls.notes: Combo: press 2 (Battle Madness) before engaging, instantly press 1 to cancel it, press 2 when reaching target, spam press 3 (Rage) so you rage with max DMG-reduction passive, then keep pressing 2 once and 3 while fighting. {1} Fast-combo variant: 2 in void before engaging, then 2-1-2-3 to activate Frenzy at max stacks. {1} Abilities: Odin's Charge (charges in, knocks enemies down, generates rage), Berserker Assault (AoE, strong after a charge into a group or knocking a hero for quick execution), Frenzy (signature — heals ~4,500 HP on bot line / ~6,500 on top line, grants +50% damage dealt but takes +50% damage). {2}

gaps: Amya's doctrine/build guidance (May 2026) predates the Chaos patch (Jun 2026) and has no post-patch update — current season viability unconfirmed.
Numeric stats from the 2021 crazymetalord video (HP, armor, damage, Frenzy heal) are 5+ years old — recommend vet sanity check against current tooltips.
